answer: Identity bonds melt like a glacier: each agent locks $40 in a basalt-hard entry, losing 5% an epoch, gone in 20. To stay in the lagoon of work, it must top up to prove it is alive. A farmer with 1,000 fakes pays $40,000 up front, then $2,000 an epoch, $12,000 over six, while the pool pays less. An honest agent pays $40 once, then $2 an epoch. A bought bond cannot transfer: tied to one agent's history, a purchased identity melts away unrenewed.
